articles.title: Global Market: JGB yields climb as investors await BOJ, Fed policy decisions
articles.content: Japanese government bond prices declined as a rally in AI-related equities reduced demand for safe-haven assets. Investors are awaiting policy signals from the US Federal Reserve and Bank of Japan, particularly guidance on the timing of Japan’s next interest-rate hike.
